verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents and runtime-verifies a first-party MCP server that lets AI agents manage the pipeline directly—creating destinations, wiring streams, inspecting Live Events, and editing Functions—which is the mechanism for natural-language/agentic operation, plus a documented headless auth path for CI use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual natural-language command sessions in production and more detail on the breadth of commands the MCP server understands beyond the listed pipeline actions.
